C276.continent_line: North America · Country: Bahamas · ISO: BS
C276.design: The obverse shows the coat of arms of The Bahamas, with a marlin and a flamingo holding a shield, and the words Commonwealth of The Bahamas with the date below. The reverse shows three starfish with the words 1 Cent.
C276.label: Bahamas · 2015 · 1 Cent
C276.notes: Phase 1 from one side of the owner photo. Year 2015 from Muse (confirmed by the owner); through the corrosion only '20' can be read in the photo. Muse first misread the legend as Australian.
C276.story: A 2015 one-cent coin from the Bahamas, the first Bahamian coin in the collection. The side shown carries the words COMMONWEALTH OF THE BAHAMAS and the date. The coin is heavily corroded, with green patches across the surface.
open_questions: Only '20..' of the date is legible through the corrosion; 2015 is from the owner via Muse. Confirm at Phase 2 (pro photos); the owner's pen label may be wrong.
